title: A stumble outside, a broken stone at home
odia:
ଦାଣ୍ଡରେ ପଥର ଝୁଣ୍ଟିଚି
ଘରେ ଶିଳ ଭାଙ୍ଗୁଚି।
literal_meaning: Someone has stumbled over a stone in the road; at home, they are breaking the grinding slab.
meaning_odia: ଦାଣ୍ଡରେ ପଥରରେ ଝୁଣ୍ଟିବା ପରେ ଘରର ଶିଳ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାର ଦୁଇଟି କାମ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଜାଗାର ବିରକ୍ତି ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦୋଷ ଜିନିଷ ଉପରେ ସୁଝାଇବାର ଅସଂଗତି ଏଠାରେ ଦିଶୁଛି। ରାଗ କଥାଟି ମୂଳରେ ନାହିଁ; କାମ ଦୁଇଟିର ସମ୍ପର୍କରୁ ଏହି ଅର୍ଥ କରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The stone that caused the stumble is outside; the stone being broken is a useful household grinding slab. We read the mismatch as displaced anger: frustration with one thing is taken out on another. The verse gives the two actions, while this emotional link is editorial interpretation.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After an irritating delay outside, someone comes home and angrily damages an unrelated object. Another person recalls the road stone and the grinding slab.
cultural_context: Both objects are stone, but they occupy different places and serve different purposes. That superficial resemblance makes the retaliation intelligible as a comic mistake without making it reasonable.
